why: o4-mini is shut down 2026-10-23 and is the only snapshot behind its alias. Everything here was produced by it; after that date it cannot be reproduced.

git.head_subject: An accession number overstates what the index holds

contents.index_manifest.json: vector index state — without it retrieval cases are not comparable
contents.phantom_slices_spent.json: which PHANTOM rows the judge selection consumed

known_gaps: per-case narrative correctness and coverage-boundary results were lost — they lived only in a scratch directory the system reaped. Only the aggregates survive, in Obsidian note 30.
the index is an LRU cache at 98.6% of cap; it churned during the 2026-10-02 runs, so retrieval-dependent cases saw different coverage depending on their position in the run.
